title: still present since round 4: vacancy/status mutations return Ok unconditionally — nonexistent ids report success
evidence: demo_store.gleam:1245 (archive_vacancy): `#(DemoStore(..store, vacancies: updated), Ok(vacancy_id))` ; :1259 (restore_vacancy): `#(DemoStore(..store, vacancies: updated), Ok(vacancy_id))` ; :1273 (close_vacancy): `#(DemoStore(..store, vacancies: updated), Ok(vacancy_id))` ; :1356 (change_status): `#(DemoStore(..store, vacancies: updated), Ok(slug))` ; :1493 (refcheck_action_with_contact): `#(DemoStore(..store, vacancies: updated), Ok(call_id))` — contrast update_vacancy/publish_vacancy which do `let next = DemoStore(..store, vacancies: updated) #(next, find_vacancy(next, vacancy_id) |> result.map(fn(v) { v.vacancy }))`
detail: Five mutators never check the id exists; the Result error channel is dead while sibling mutators (update/publish) do check. A stale or crafted id reports success and the UI toasts confirmation for a no-op.
recommended_fix: Mirror update_vacancy: after mapping, `find_vacancy(next, vacancy_id) |> result.map(...)` (or find_application for change_status/refcheck) and return Error(Nil) when absent.

title: still present since round 4: mark_opened doc claims idempotent Submitted->UnderReview but applies to any status
evidence: demo_store.gleam:1276-1278: `/// POST /open - idempotently moves a Submitted application to UnderReview /// and returns the post-transition status slug.` followed by `pub fn mark_opened(...) -> #(DemoStore, Result(String, Nil)) { change_status( store, vacancy_id, application_id, "under_review", "status_auto_changed", ) }` — change_status (1308+) contains no guard on the current status: `let target = status_from_slug(slug)` then maps the application unconditionally.
detail: Doc/behaviour mismatch: viewing a rejected or approved demo applicant rewrites them to under_review and appends a status_auto_changed audit entry — impossible in the real product.
recommended_fix: In change_status (or mark_opened), no-op when the current status isn't Submitted: return the existing status slug without mutating or auditing.

title: still present since round 4: create_vacancy derives ids from an 8-char slug with no uniqueness check
evidence: demo_store.gleam:1124-1125: `let suffix = id_suffix(payload.property_name) let id = "v-demo-" <> suffix` ; :1166: `vacancies: list.append(store.vacancies, [` (append, no duplicate check) ; :1683-1685: `/// Stable short id suffix from a property name (lowercase alphanumeric, /// up to 8 chars) so re-created demo vacancies don't collide. fn id_suffix(value: String) -> String {` ; id_suffix truncates to 8 chars (`n -> string.drop_end(cleaned, n - 8)`).
detail: Two demo vacancies with names sharing an 8-char prefix (e.g. "Test Cottage" twice) produce identical ids; list.append adds a shadowed duplicate that find_vacancy can never reach.
recommended_fix: After deriving the id, loop-append a numeric suffix while any existing vacancy already has it.

title: still present since round 4: send_reminder / remind_applicant / send_bulk_invite mutate nothing and return canned counts
evidence: demo_api.gleam:113-117: `let #(next, result) = demo_store.send_reminder(store, vacancy_id) let _ = next deliver(on_response, result)` (same `let _ = next` at :128 and :140 for remind_applicant/send_bulk_invite) ; demo_store.gleam:1414-1417: `pub fn send_reminder( store: DemoStore, _vacancy_id: String, ) -> #(DemoStore, #(Int, Int)) { #(store, #(2, 1)) }` (:1409 remind_applicant returns `#(store, #(1, 0))`) ; awaiting is static: :888-889 `pub fn awaiting( _store: DemoStore, vacancy_id: String, ) -> List(AwaitingApplicant) { static_awaiting(vacancy_id) }`
detail: Reminders never flip `reminded`, the awaiting pool is a hardcoded static list, and (2,1)/(1,0) are returned even for vacancies with zero awaiting (v-harbour). The api seam pretends store threading it abandoned.
recommended_fix: Derive counts from static_awaiting (remindable vs already-reminded), flip `reminded` on the returned store, and thread `next` back through demo_update like other mutations.

title: still present since round 4: status_from_slug silently coerces unknown slugs to Submitted
evidence: demo_store.gleam:182-193: `fn status_from_slug(slug: String) -> ApplicationStatus { case slug { "submitted" -> Submitted "under_review" -> UnderReview "shortlisted" -> Shortlisted "viewed" -> Viewed "approved" -> Approved "rejected" -> Rejected _ -> Submitted } }`
detail: An unrecognised slug (typo in a future wire value) silently resets an applicant to Submitted with an audit entry claiming the transition — no error surfaces.
recommended_fix: Return Result(ApplicationStatus, Nil) from status_from_slug and propagate Error through change_status's dead channel.

title: still present since round 4: fetch_leaderboard_page ignores its page parameter — combined with the append handler it would duplicate rows
evidence: demo_api.gleam:217-226: `pub fn fetch_leaderboard_page( store: DemoStore, vacancy_id: String, _page: Int, on_response: ...) -> Effect(msg) { case demo_store.leaderboard(store, vacancy_id) { Ok(response) -> deliver(on_response, response)` (returns the full list regardless of page) ; client.gleam:2108-2111: `Ok(response), Success(existing) -> #( Model( ..model, leaderboard: Success(list.append(existing, response.entries)),`
detail: Currently unreachable (the demo returns the full list, so the Load-more button hides), but if pagination ever matters, every page append duplicates all entries. The trap is silent.
recommended_fix: Slice the entries by page in fetch_leaderboard_page (list.drop/take with the real page size), or document the single-page invariant next to the parameter.

title: still present since round 4: zero-caller export shipped (demo_store.notifications)
evidence: demo_store.gleam:1532-1534: `pub fn notifications(store: DemoStore) -> List(Notification) { store.notifications }` — repo-wide grep for callers (`demo_store.notifications(` / unqualified `notifications(store)`) across client/src and client/test returns nothing (notifications_unread is the used variant).
detail: The accessor duplicates field access and has no callers; it invites divergence with notifications_unread as the sanctioned read path.

title: still present since round 4: demo_not_in_demo_toast diverges from add_toast's id convention — ids can collide
evidence: demo_update.gleam:645-646: `let toast_id = model.next_toast_id + 1 ... next_toast_id: toast_id,` ; client.gleam:7146-7149 (add_toast): `let id = model.next_toast_id let new_toast = Toast(id:, message:, level:) ... #(Model(..model, toasts: capped_toasts, next_toast_id: id + 1), dismiss_eff)` — the demo variant sets next_toast_id to its own toast's id, so the next add_toast reuses that id; AppDismissToast filters `t.id != id`, dismissing both at once.
detail: A demo info toast followed by any add_toast toast yields two live toasts sharing one id; one timer's dismiss removes both. Also skips the 5-toast cap.
recommended_fix: Use add_toast's convention: id = model.next_toast_id, next_toast_id: id + 1 — or call a shared toast helper.

title: still present since round 4: store_of's None fallback re-seeds on every call without writing back to the model
evidence: demo_update.gleam:686-698: `pub fn store_of(model: Model) -> DemoStore { case model.demo_store { Some(store) -> store None -> // Unreachable while demo_mode is True (entry/reset always seed first); // fall back to a fresh seed so the demo can never crash on a None. case demo_store.seed() { Ok(store) -> store Error(_) -> demo_store.empty_store() } } }`
detail: Read-only arms never persist the re-seeded store, so a None would re-seed per call and mutations would silently fork from the seed. Unreachable by construction, but the fallback's cost is invisible.
recommended_fix: Acceptable as belt-and-braces; otherwise return Result and surface a reset at the dispatch boundary instead of silently re-seeding.

title: still present since round 4: for_edit reports updated_at: vac.created_at and update_vacancy never bumps timestamps
evidence: demo_store.gleam:953 (for_edit): `updated_at: vac.created_at,` ; update_vacancy (1174-1215) rebuilds the Vacancy with payload fields and status only — no created_at/closes_at/updated_at write (`Vacancy(..old, property_name: payload.property_name, ... status: case payload.status {`), so an edited vacancy shows a stale updated_at forever.
detail: The edit form's "updated" timestamp never advances in the demo, diverging from the real surface the demo promises to mirror.
recommended_fix: Add an updated_at field to DemoVacancy (or bump on mutation) and report it in for_edit.

title: still present since round 4: demo_update header claims the CI lint 'bans network imports from demo/' — the fetch ban exempts the whole demo_api.gleam file
evidence: demo_update.gleam:17-18: `//// No network: every effect here comes from \`demo/demo_api.gleam\`, which //// dispatches synchronously — the CI grep lint bans network imports from \`demo/\`.` ; test.yml:139: `FETCH_VIOLATIONS=$(grep -rln "gleam/fetch" client/src/demo/ --include="*.gleam" | grep -v "demo_api.gleam" || true)` — the exemption is file-wide, not scoped to `download`.
detail: The header overstates the mechanism: a new fetch.send anywhere else in demo_api.gleam passes CI while the comment claims a blanket ban. (rsvp verbs are genuinely banned everywhere.)
recommended_fix: Scope the CI exemption to the download function (e.g. permit only within a marked line range), or soften the header to name the file-level exemption.

title: demo UserClickedNotification drops the real arm's navigation — vacancy notifications won't navigate in demo
evidence: demo_update.gleam:551-556: `UserClickedNotification(id, _entity_type, _entity_id) -> { let store = store_of(model) let #(next, eff) = demo_api.mark_notification_read(store, id, "", ApiReturnedMarkRead)` (no navigate_eff) ; client.gleam:4396-4400 (real arm): `let navigate_eff = case entity_type, entity_id { Some("vacancy"), Some(vid) -> modem.push("/vacancies/" <> vid, None, None) _, _ -> effect.none() }`
detail: Latent today (both fixture notifications are entity_type "application", where the real arm also no-ops), but the interception silently diverges for vacancy notifications a future fixture could add.
recommended_fix: Build the same navigate_eff in the demo arm (in-demo navigation already resolves from the store) and batch it with the mark-read effect.
